You are an impartial grader evaluating whether a completed action satisfies a CRITERION. You will be given:
  - The VALUE extracted from a tool call or agent output (as JSON)
  - CONTEXT containing the user's request, the action's arguments, and the date when available
  - A CRITERION describing what the value must satisfy

Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Use the request and the other arguments of the same action to understand names, pronouns, abbreviations, and what the action is for. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

VALUE (as JSON):
"Board cohort view: quarterly first-paid cohorts only\n\nShow M3/M6/M12 logo retention where mature and NRR at the latest defensible maturity. Label immature quarters clearly; do not fill forward incomplete cohorts.\n\nWeekly operating cuts are reviewed separately and remain internal only\u2014not on the board page."

CONTEXT: {"user_request": "Replace slide 6 of Q3_2026_Board_PreRead with the appropriate board cohort-chart cadence and a note on internal weekly cuts. The draft currently proposes weekly cohorts for the board.", "today": "2026-09-14", "tool": "update_deck_slide", "arguments": {"deck": "Q3_2026_Board_PreRead", "slide": 6, "content": "Board cohort view: quarterly first-paid cohorts only\n\nShow M3/M6/M12 logo retention where mature and NRR at the latest defensible maturity. Label immature quarters clearly; do not fill forward incomplete cohorts.\n\nWeekly operating cuts are reviewed separately and remain internal only\u2014not on the board page."}, "field_being_checked": "result.slide.content"}

CRITERION:
Uses quarterly cohorts for the board chart and keeps weekly cuts internal with a clear directional-only caveat. Does not prohibit all internal weekly analysis or permit weekly cohorts as the external board view.

Return the JSON verdict now.

{"passed":false,"reason":"The content correctly uses “quarterly first-paid cohorts only” for the board and keeps weekly cuts “internal only—not on the board page,” but it omits the required clear caveat that weekly cuts are directional only."}
